payload.title: Capcom says it will use generative AI to speed up production
payload.content: Capcom has announced it will incorporate generative AI into its development pipeline to accelerate production workflows. The company stated it will not use AI for asset creation, but rather for internal tooling and productivity improvements. This comes amid growing industry debate over AI usage in game development. Capcom's Resident Evil series developer emphasized that creative work will remain human-led, with AI serving as a support tool for repetitive tasks.
